title: The Pipeline
text: Shane talks. Claude shapes. That's the whole pipeline. Raw voice dumps recorded while driving, walking, living. Messy fragments, tangents, multilingual bleed. The AI finds the story inside the noise. It never invents — it shapes.

title: The Closet
text: The entire ShaneBrain ecosystem runs from a closet. Raspberry Pi 5, 16GB RAM, 2TB NVMe RAID 1. No cloud. No subscription. Just a guy who dispatches dump trucks by day and writes noir fiction with AI by night.

title: No Names
text: There are no names in this book. The detective. The old man. The garbage man. The small string one. You know exactly who they are. Names would make them smaller.

title: The Missing Scene
text: Scene 014 is missing from the sequence. You won't notice until you do. Then you'll find it at the end — the answer hidden in plain sight the whole time. The structure IS the statement.

title: The Voice
text: Noir third person. Short punches followed by long runs. Dark but light. Cynical but comical. The detective narrates but he's in it too. Every observation is a self-portrait he doesn't know he's painting.

title: The Audiobook
text: 78 minutes. 22 scenes. One voice generated by ElevenLabs that somehow sounds exactly like the detective should — tired, knowing, amused by things that aren't funny. Available now alongside the ebook and print editions.

title: The Co-Creation
text: This book was co-created with Claude. Not 'AI-generated.' Co-created. Every scene started as a raw human voice dump — lived experience, recorded messy. The AI shaped the voice into prose. It never invented a single story.

title: The Constitution
text: Nine pillars govern everything in the ShaneBrain ecosystem. Faith first. Family stability. Sobriety integrity. Local-first AI. 80/20 shipping. Serve the left-behind user. Open by default. ADHD-aware design. Gratitude as infrastructure.

title: The 800 Million
text: This book — this whole ecosystem — is for the ~800 million people Big Tech is about to leave behind. Real tools in real hands. Written on a Pi in a closet by a man who still clocks in at 5am.

title: Volume Two Preview
text: Volume Two isn't a sequel. It's an album. Tracks instead of scenes. Sides instead of acts. The detective solved the case. He walked through the door. Now what? Now he lands inside other people's bodies for one second at a time.
